sources.title: Aleph Alpha Kolibri: What Germany's 'Sovereign' Open-Weight AI Model ...
sources.snippet: Learn more. On October 3, 2026, German AI company Aleph Alpha published Kolibri, a new open-weight AI language model, as downloadable files on Hugging Face under the Apache 2.0 license. The company announced it in a post on its official blog and on its X account, and published the technical details on the Kolibri-1 model card.
